I classified this as **trivial** and assigned it to **sonnet**, with no design round.

- **Where the text is:** the (i) button in `src/views/Trivia/MiniGame.tsx` opens the "How to play" instructions modal. The descriptive text is the `game.intro` paragraph on line 16 of `src/components/modals/InstructionsModal.tsx`. Removing it is a single-line, single-file change.
- **Why sonnet, not haiku:** the classify rubric says removing a visible UI element goes to sonnet because the layout needs a visual check. The 2026-09-16 entry in `DECISIONS.md` made the same call on a similar task. The rubric decides it outright, so it isn't a close call and I added nothing to `DECISIONS.md`.
- **Scope assumption:** I took "descriptive text" to mean only the intro paragraph. The numbered rules and the "Got it" button stay.
- **Risk:** low. The change touches no auth, data pipeline, multiplayer or protected surface, and `RETRO.md` has no parked tasks.
